interaction geometry; improve truthful product specific monetization; extend existing workspace handoff only if real consumer evidence justified it; and finish with release/deployment truth rather non wrapping footer that could collide with the full width mobile favorite control. the first full rewrite reached 140 lines and was rejected. it was split into sheet.css, sheetlayout.css, and sheetcontent.css, with a dedicated css contract test. the current layout enforces a 44px close target, 44px wallet/account links, safe area left/right/bottom treatment, horizontal containment, wrapping footer behavior, and narrow screen link layout. product aware radiance positioning completed without changing fulfillment. all 80 live radiance actions remain 25 credits, permanent durable entitlements, handler backed, and server owned. offer descriptions now name the actual product. games explicitly state cosmetic only and no gameplay advantage. apps explicitly state purely decorative and core functionality unchanged. wallet settlement health completed earlier in this hardening sequence and preserved through every subsequent regression. the authenticated current account health route is get only, text/plain, no store, read only under the wallet lock, identity free, and detects stale holds / contradictory execution topology while recognizing legitimate already owned deduplication. retention and catalog continuity completed earlier in this hardening sequence and preserved. product route only recent/favorite memory remains bounded, local, non content bearing, and browser proven. apps/games catalog ordering/decorations remain green. startup performance measured, not cosmetically hidden. the isolated server reached http readiness in roughly eight seconds while explicit lifecycle awaits consumed only milliseconds. module loading—not db/auth awaits—is the dominant cost. request time families were identified, but the remaining safe optimization boundary crosses legacy config/auth/dosdb infrastructure. no fake post bind readiness trick was introduced. workspace/embed handoff architecture confirmed, exhaustive consumer audit incomplete. existing workspace launch descriptors and versioned embed protocol already provide path confinement, origin/direction checks, and typed launch destinations. a duplicate weaker handoff protocol was deliberately not added. recursive consumer searches repeatedly stalled and remain an audit item. deployment the public awtsmoos.com deployment is live and independently verified. the local hardened checkout is not blindly pushed because the working tree contains 1,510 dirty paths and local committed head is 3 commits ahead / 26 behind origin/main. production is sha locked through github actions and a hetzner hard reset deployment, so promoting this tree wholesale would risk unrelated concurrent work. what remains honestly incomplete prove a coherent clean release candidate from current origin/main that includes all tracked and untracked dependencies used by the hardened local graph. run the production quality workflow against that isolated candidate before any main push. finish exhaustive workspace launch consumer mapping. design a coherent non json legacy config/auth/dosdb migration before aggressive startup lazy load work. the current green local product is materially stronger; the remaining work is release isolation and legacy migration, not a broken commerce or catalog core.
